column1: # NDMW.AFS entry 861 (`common/p_susanoo.igb`, the player Susanoomon's model pack) -- every
# geometry attribute the offline chain resolves, by the same rule as entry 621 (findings
# block lists this array's streams and whose `_numVerts` is the count; a stream block's
# `_memSize` is its content size exactly (12*_numVerts positions, 8*_numVerts UVs) and the
# pool is laid out 4-byte aligned.  `_stripLengths` gives the primitive lengths, validated by
# sum == _numVerts.  This pack is the second alignment the chain finder must handle: its
# records start at an ODD file offset (the first record is at +0x260f), while the stage packs
# start at 2-mod-4, so `igb_inst.find_chains` scans every offset rather than stepping by two
# columns: vertexArray  primType  numPrims  numVerts  vdata  numLengths  stream ids  name
# scripts/verify_models_layout.py re-derives every row from the pack.
# The three shapes are the three actor LODs of the player (beModelCtrlNode2 -> igLod ->
# three igActor), not body parts; the live names are P_susanoo_Skin0Shape0/1/2.
